description.content: Enrolls a user's biometric selfie for future authentication. The selfie and liveness images are uploaded, validated at entry, then processed asynchronously (passive liveness, active liveness). Results are delivered via callback URL.

header.description: Source SDK identifier.
Source SDK version.
ISO 8601 timestamp used as the salt when computing SmileID-Request-Signature. Required when your Smile ID account is configured to use SDK/partner secret HMAC authentication.

HMAC signature of the raw HTTP request body, computed with your SDK/partner secret and the value of SmileID-Timestamp as salt. Required when your Smile ID account is configured to use SDK/partner secret HMAC authentication.
Partner-provided user identifier. If omitted, a TypeID is generated automatically.

formdata.description: (Required) JPEG selfie image used as the enrollment reference photo. Must be a clear, well-lit, front-facing photo.
(Required) Array of JPEG liveness sequence images captured during the liveness check. These images are used for passive and active liveness verification.
(Required) Consumer-stated PII fields for the user. Either email or phone_number must be provided.
If true, allows re-enrollment for a user who is already enrolled. The existing enrollment will be replaced with the new selfie. If false (default), enrollment fails if the user is already enrolled.
URL to receive the async result callback. Falls back to partner default if omitted. Must be on the partner's allowed callback domains list.
Force a specific result code in sandbox/test environments. Only effective when the partner account is in sandbox mode.
Arbitrary key-value metadata for partner reference.
Additional metadata entries (e.g., SDK telemetry, device info).

response.name: Accepted — verification submitted for async processing.

info.name: Smile ID V3 Authentication Biometric Enrollment API

description.content:
Smile ID V3 identity verification API for Africa: Biometric KYC, Document Verification, Enhanced KYC/Doc Verification, SmartSelfie enrollment/authentication/compare, plus core service and user resources. Assembled verbatim from the per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments published in the Smile ID GitBook API reference (docs.usesmileid.com/api-reference).
